g.text: Memory amplitude decay is not information erasure.
Axes use balanced condition means at fixed anchor times;
they are descriptive and are not decoder fits.
Random edge cuts match count, magnitude, sign and timing.
Condition-held-out probes differ from noise-repeat probes.
Rates are dimensionless. Conditions are not biological repeats.
Figure 3 | Activity-dependent rule-memory handoff and causal controls | one_hot
